This beans plot is small and intercropped with our maize, so we save the fertilizer we get for the main maize plot. I will spread manure on this plot because it costs nothing and helps the soil. I will plant the bean seeds we kept from last season, and my family will weed and harvest it by hand—we do not hire workers for such a small piece, and we rely only on the rains.
